placements.title: Empirical reference verification establishes operational readiness across observing bands
placements.frame: How does empirical baseline verification establish and validate instrument precision across operational bands?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 establish the empirical calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph at 88.4 MHz, verified across the full observing band against June reference plates to ensure instrument readiness.
